item: 18650 Li-ion cell, genuine Samsung 25R / LG MJ1 / Molicel P28A class
notes: Seen 3.99-10 EUR per cell. You own old cells: test them first and use a matched pair (same voltage within 0.05 V before joining). Carry-on only.

notes: All four cells from the same batch and the same model, brought to the same voltage within 0.05 V before joining. Build 2P, then 2S, one BMS only: see wiring.md, section 'Four-cell option (2S2P)' and diagrams/battery-4cell.png. Needs a bigger battery cradle in the base (about 77 x 80 x 21 mm). The robot then weighs about 3.3 kg by the sum of this list (3.03 kg by the CAD).

item: Battery holder for 2 x 18650
notes: 77x40x21 mm per mechanical doc. The BMS needs a wire at the point between the two cells (BM): use a 2-cell holder where you can reach that point, or two single-cell holders. 4-cell option: four single-cell holders in total, or two 2-cell holders whose middle point you can reach and join (next line).

item: Battery holder, 2nd set for the 4-cell option (four single-cell holders in total, or two 2-cell holders whose middle point you can reach and join)
notes: This line is one more 2-cell holder or two more single-cell holders (about 2 EUR either way, ASSUMED). A 2-cell holder that is wired in series inside has no middle wire and cannot make the pairs: check this when it arrives, and if there is no middle wire or tag, use single-cell holders. How to join them (2P, then 2S): wiring.md, section 7 'Four-cell option (2S2P)' and diagrams/battery-4cell.png.
